units.rawText: In the Doll barracks' tactical center, Krasno Town.
units.displayText: In the Doll barracks' tactical center, Krasno Town.

spans.text: In the Doll barracks' tactical center, Krasno Town.

units.rawText: Go on. Tell me what happened and whose idea it was.
units.displayText: Go on. Tell me what happened and whose idea it was.

spans.text: Go on. Tell me what happened and whose idea it was.

units.rawText: Sir, it was my idea, sir.
units.displayText: Sir, it was my idea, sir.

spans.text: Sir, it was my idea, sir.

units.rawText: You're in sync. That's the first time I've seen the two of you so coordinated.
units.displayText: You're in sync. That's the first time I've seen the two of you so coordinated.

spans.text: You're in sync. That's the first time I've seen the two of you so coordinated.

units.rawText: I've already heard Erwin's report. Evelyn, your turn.
units.displayText: I've already heard Erwin's report. Evelyn, your turn.

spans.text: I've already heard Erwin's report. Evelyn, your turn.

units.rawText: Sir, it began earlier today, when we were obeying your orders to follow the self-determined training punishment guidelines.
units.displayText: Sir, it began earlier today, when we were obeying your orders to follow the self-determined training punishment guidelines.

spans.text: Sir, it began earlier today, when we were obeying your orders to follow the self-determined training punishment guidelines.

units.rawText: Among all the training items, Erwin and I agreed that a mock battle would be the best training for us.
units.displayText: Among all the training items, Erwin and I agreed that a mock battle would be the best training for us.

spans.text: Among all the training items, Erwin and I agreed that a mock battle would be the best training for us.

units.rawText: Excellent, you've started to blame me for it all.
units.displayText: Excellent, you've started to blame me for it all.

spans.text: Excellent, you've started to blame me for it all.

units.rawText: Sir, we wouldn't dare, sir.
units.displayText: Sir, we wouldn't dare, sir.

spans.text: Sir, we wouldn't dare, sir.

units.rawText: You wouldn't dare? You were just using your punishment to vent your dissatisfaction. Do you or do you not know the objective of this training camp!?
units.displayText: You wouldn't dare? You were just using your punishment to vent your dissatisfaction. Do you or do you not know the objective of this training camp!?

spans.text: You wouldn't dare? You were just using your punishment to vent your dissatisfaction. Do you or do you not know the objective of this training camp!?

units.rawText: Sir, it is to train a mixed unit of humans and Dolls, sir.
units.displayText: Sir, it is to train a mixed unit of humans and Dolls, sir.

spans.text: Sir, it is to train a mixed unit of humans and Dolls, sir.

units.rawText: If you'd said you didn't know, I would have thought all that P.T. in the past seven days had turned you into idiots.
units.displayText: If you'd said you didn't know, I would have thought all that P.T. in the past seven days had turned you into idiots.

spans.text: If you'd said you didn't know, I would have thought all that P.T. in the past seven days had turned you into idiots.

units.rawText: My mission is to weave you all into a rope, and to that end I deleted everything in the training plan that could have caused division between you.
units.displayText: My mission is to weave you all into a rope, and to that end I deleted everything in the training plan that could have caused division between you.

spans.text: My mission is to weave you all into a rope, and to that end I deleted everything in the training plan that could have caused division between you.

units.rawText: And now!? You've gone and done it to yourselves, haven't you!?
units.displayText: And now!? You've gone and done it to yourselves, haven't you!?

spans.text: And now!? You've gone and done it to yourselves, haven't you!?

units.rawText: <size=40>Sir, sorry, sir!</size>
units.displayText: Sir, sorry, sir!

spans.text: Sir, sorry, sir!

units.rawText: Shut up, the soldiers I train aren't so weak. "Sorry" is the most worthless word in a military camp.
units.displayText: Shut up, the soldiers I train aren't so weak. "Sorry" is the most worthless word in a military camp.

spans.text: Shut up, the soldiers I train aren't so weak. "Sorry" is the most worthless word in a military camp.

units.rawText: Tell me what you've gained from this mock battle. Erwin, you start.
units.displayText: Tell me what you've gained from this mock battle. Erwin, you start.

spans.text: Tell me what you've gained from this mock battle. Erwin, you start.

units.rawText: Sir, we have come to know the strengths and operational logic of the Dolls by fighting against them.
units.displayText: Sir, we have come to know the strengths and operational logic of the Dolls by fighting against them.

spans.text: Sir, we have come to know the strengths and operational logic of the Dolls by fighting against them.

units.rawText: Dolls have far more superior strength and mobility than human beings, but they are rigid and inflexible when it comes to dealing with change. If their plan changes, they have a hard time reacting swiftly to it.
units.displayText: Dolls have far more superior strength and mobility than human beings, but they are rigid and inflexible when it comes to dealing with change. If their plan changes, they have a hard time reacting swiftly to it.

spans.text: Dolls have far more superior strength and mobility than human beings, but they are rigid and inflexible when it comes to dealing with change. If their plan changes, they have a hard time reacting swiftly to it.

units.rawText: Oh, you're very good at reading bullet points off a list, I see.
units.displayText: Oh, you're very good at reading bullet points off a list, I see.

spans.text: Oh, you're very good at reading bullet points off a list, I see.

units.rawText: Sir, personally familiarizing yourself with a teammate's strengths and weaknesses is much more impactful than reading off a simple list, sir!
units.displayText: Sir, personally familiarizing yourself with a teammate's strengths and weaknesses is much more impactful than reading off a simple list, sir!

spans.text: Sir, personally familiarizing yourself with a teammate's strengths and weaknesses is much more impactful than reading off a simple list, sir!

units.rawText: Evelyn, what did you learn?
units.displayText: Evelyn, what did you learn?

spans.text: Evelyn, what did you learn?

units.rawText: Sir, during this adversarial training scenario, we were defeated for the reasons cited by Erwin.
units.displayText: Sir, during this adversarial training scenario, we were defeated for the reasons cited by Erwin.

spans.text: Sir, during this adversarial training scenario, we were defeated for the reasons cited by Erwin.

units.rawText: Human soldiers are far more adaptable than our processing abilities, but I believe Erwin's abilities are superior to the average soldier.
units.displayText: Human soldiers are far more adaptable than our processing abilities, but I believe Erwin's abilities are superior to the average soldier.

spans.text: Human soldiers are far more adaptable than our processing abilities, but I believe Erwin's abilities are superior to the average soldier.

units.rawText: Don't try to excuse your failure.
units.displayText: Don't try to excuse your failure.

spans.text: Don't try to excuse your failure.

units.rawText: This kind of confrontational training has given us a keen sense of both sides' merits and flaws. I believe it was a very good plan!
units.displayText: This kind of confrontational training has given us a keen sense of both sides' merits and flaws. I believe it was a very good plan!

spans.text: This kind of confrontational training has given us a keen sense of both sides' merits and flaws. I believe it was a very good plan!

units.rawText: Python snorts in amusement, as though he's finally heard a satisfactory answer.
units.displayText: Python snorts in amusement, as though he's finally heard a satisfactory answer.

spans.text: Python snorts in amusement, as though he's finally heard a satisfactory answer.

units.rawText: Neatly put. Thanks to the ruckus you raised, you made me realize something I'd overlooked before.
units.displayText: Neatly put. Thanks to the ruckus you raised, you made me realize something I'd overlooked before.

spans.text: Neatly put. Thanks to the ruckus you raised, you made me realize something I'd overlooked before.

units.rawText: This is...
units.displayText: This is...

spans.text: This is...

units.rawText: The grades for our previous exercise?

units.rawText: Mock battles are a big event and a late-stage one. Typically, they're reserved for when the training camp is nearing its end, as a comprehensive assessment of what you've learned.
units.displayText: Mock battles are a big event and a late-stage one. Typically, they're reserved for when the training camp is nearing its end, as a comprehensive assessment of what you've learned.

spans.text: Mock battles are a big event and a late-stage one. Typically, they're reserved for when the training camp is nearing its end, as a comprehensive assessment of what you've learned.

units.rawText: This single mock battle covered everything you learned over the past week and your performance exceeded my expectations.
units.displayText: This single mock battle covered everything you learned over the past week and your performance exceeded my expectations.

spans.text: This single mock battle covered everything you learned over the past week and your performance exceeded my expectations.

units.rawText: Other than a few small blemishes, both of your platoons did very well on the whole.
units.displayText: Other than a few small blemishes, both of your platoons did very well on the whole.

spans.text: Other than a few small blemishes, both of your platoons did very well on the whole.

units.rawText: Negative emotions are much easier to use than positive ones. The two of you taught me a lesson in that respect.
